offering_description.value: Develops and publishes curriculum and learning materials for K–12 schools, colleges, universities, and working professionals. It delivers them through print textbooks, digital courseware, adaptive learning and assessment platforms, and professional reference subscriptions.

primary_products.value: K–12 curriculum materials; college textbooks and e-books; digital courseware; adaptive learning and assessment software; professional reference publications

primary_services.value: Educator professional development; curriculum implementation training

customer_segment.value: B2G: Public school districts, state education agencies, and public colleges and universities; B2B: Private schools, private colleges and universities, libraries, and healthcare institutions; B2C: Students, educators, and working professionals buying course materials or reference resources directly

end_markets.value: K–12 education; higher education; medical education and clinical practice; professional education

revenue_model.value: product sales: Print textbooks, workbooks, and professional reference books; subscription: Term-based access to digital courseware, adaptive learning tools, and professional reference libraries; licensing or royalties: Institutional licenses for digital curriculum, assessment tools, and courseware; service fees: Educator professional development and curriculum implementation training
revenue_model.category: product sales; subscription; licensing or royalties; service fees

value_chain_position.value: other: Commissions, edits, and publishes instructional and reference content for schools, colleges, students, and professionals; software / platform: Combines instructional content with assessment and practice tools for educators and students; service provider: Uses curriculum and teaching expertise to train educators and help school districts implement programs

geography_served.value: global: United States and international markets across Canada, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: K–12 curricula, higher education textbooks and courseware, adaptive learning tools, and professional reference publishing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving school districts, colleges, universities, and other institutions; online: Company websites selling books, digital course access, and reference subscriptions; third-party retail: Campus bookstores, booksellers, and online retailers; partners / resellers: Campus bookstore programs that bundle digital materials with courses and local distribution partners in international markets
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; online; third-party retail; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Student data privacy under FERPA, COPPA, and state laws, plus state textbook adoption and public procurement rules

notes: Separate fees for training and implementation vary by contract.
